paragraphs: Having thus addressed his both brothers, Rama, the descendant of Kakuthstha of unmitigated prowess, again said to Lakshmana, in words pregnant with morality : — “O Lakshmana, having invited Vasishtha, the foremost of twiceborn ones, conversant with all the rites of Aswamedha, Vamadeva, Javali, and Kashyapa and consulted with them duly I 5hall set free a horse gifted with all marks.” Hearing the words of Rama, Lakshmana, of unmitigated prowess, invited all those Brahmanas and approached Rama. Seeing them, Rama saluted them touching their feet. And the Brahmanas too, beholding the irrepressible celestial, like Raghava, welcomed him with blessings. Thereupon Rama, with folded hands, asked of those leading twice-born ones, questions regarding the Aswamedha sacrifice. And hearing the words of Rama, they, too, saluting the deity Rudra, began to speak highly of the ceremony of horse-sacrifice.

And being informed from the Brahmanas of many unheard of virtues of Ashvvamedha, Rama was greatly delighted. And according to their desire he said to Lakshmana : — " O thou having long arms, do thou soon send an emissary to the high-souled Sugriva, communicating unto him ‘ Do thou come here to enjoy festivities in the company of all those highly powerful monkeys and bears, under thee ; may good betide thee.’ See that Bhibhishana of unequalled prowess, the king of Rakshasas, encircled by his followers, coursing at will, may be present at the horse sacrifice. Let the great kings, wishing my welfare with their followers, be present at the sacrific. O Lakshmana, do thou also invite carefully, for witnessing the ceremony .other pious foreign kings who are friendly unto me.

O thou having long arms, do thou also invite the Rishis, having asceticism for their wealth and other pious Brahmanas living in various provinces. Do thou also Invite actors and songsters. Do thou order that a spacious, sacrificial ground may be made on the banks of the river Gomoti in the Naimisha forest. O thou having long arms, that part of the country is best suited and holy. And let ceremonies, invoking peace, be celebrated everywhere. O thou conversant with piety, do thou soon invite hundreds of subjects, so that they all, having witnessed the ceremony in the Naimi.sha forest, may return delighted and honored. O thou having long arms, let Bharata go before with a jRAA/A YANA. million of beasts carrying rice, sessamun seed, Kindneybean, Chickpea, pulse, Masha (a sort of Kindney bean) salt, oil, clarihed butter and a hundred koti of silver and golden coins.

Let merchants, to set up shops on the way, actors, dancers, cooks, and many youthful females follow Bharata. Let soldiers go before him. And let the highly illustrious Bharata, with children, old men,Brahmanas, citizens, servants, cashiers, mothers, wives and the golden image of my wife to be initiated at the sacrifice, go before.” According to the command of Rama, Bharata, with Satrughna, made arrangements for highly valuable quarters, food, drink and clothes. And the highly powerful monkeys with Sugriva and Brahmanas engaged in the work of distribution. And BIbhishana, surrounded by various Rakshas and females, engaged in the service of the high-souled Rishis intent on hard penances.

verses.sa:
एतदाख्याय काकुत्स्थो भ्रातृभ्याममितप्रभः ।
लक्ष्मणं पुनरेवाह धर्मयुक्तमिदं वचः ॥

वसिष्ठं वामदेवं च जाबालिमथ कश्यपम् ।
द्विजांश्च सर्वप्रवरानश्वमेधपुरस्कृतान् ॥

एतान्सर्वान्समानीय मन्त्रयित्वा च लक्ष्मण ।
हयं लक्षणसम्पन्नं विमोक्ष्यामि समाधिना ॥

तद्वाक्यं राघवेणोक्तं श्रुत्वा त्वरितविक्रमः ।
द्विजान्सर्वान्समाहूय दर्शयामास राघवम् ॥

ते दृष्ट्वा देवसङ्काशं कृतपादाभिवन्दनम् ।
राघवं सुदुराधर्षमाशीर्भिः समपूजयन् ॥

प्राञ्जलिः स तदा भूत्वा राघवो द्विजसत्तमान् ।
आचचक्षे ऽश्वमेधस्य ह्यभिप्रायं महायशाः ॥

ते तु रामस्य तच्छ्रुत्वा नमस्कृत्वा वृषध्वजम् ।
अश्वमेधं द्विजाः सर्वे पूजयन्ति स्म सर्वशः ॥

स तेषां द्विजमुख्यानां वाक्यमद्भुतदर्शनम् ।
अश्वमेधाश्रितं श्रुत्वा भृशं प्रीतो ऽभवत्तदा ॥

विज्ञाय कर्म तत्तेषां रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत् ।
प्रेषयस्व द्रुतं दूतान् सुग्रीवाय महात्मने ॥

यथा महद्भिर्हरिभिर्बहुभिश्च वनौकसाम् ।
सार्धमागच्छ भद्रं ते ह्यनुभोक्तुं महोत्सवम् ॥

बिभीषणश्च रक्षोभिः कामगैर्बहुभिर्वृतः ।
अश्वमेधं महायज्ञमायात्वतुलविक्रमः ॥

राजानश्च महाभागा ये मे प्रियचिकीर्षवः ।
सानुगाः क्षिप्रमायान्तु यज्ञं द्रष्टुमनुत्तमम् ॥

देशान्तरगता ये च द्विजा धर्मसमाहिताः ।
आमन्त्रयस्व तान्सर्वानश्वमेधाय लक्ष्मण ॥

ऋषयश्च महाबाहो आहूयन्तां तपोधनाः ।
देशान्तरगताः सर्वे सदाराश्च द्विजातयः ।
तथैव तालावचरास्तथैव नटनर्तकाः ॥

यज्ञवाटश्च सुमहान्गोमत्या नैमिशे वने ।
आज्ञाप्यतां महाबाहो तद्धि पुण्यमनुत्तमम् ॥
शान्तयश्च महाबाहो प्रवर्त्यन्तां समन्ततः ॥

शतशश्चापि धर्मज्ञाः क्रतुमुख्यमनुत्तमम् ।
अनुभूय महायज्ञं नैमिशे रघुनन्दन ॥

तुष्टः पुष्टश्च सर्वो ऽसौ मानितश्च यथाविधि ।
प्रीतिं यास्यति धर्मज्ञ शीघ्रमामन्त्र्यतां जनः ॥

शतं वाहसहस्राणां तण्डुलानां वपुष्मताम् ।
अयुतं तिलमुद्गानां प्रयात्वग्रे महाबल ॥

चणकानां कुलित्थानां माषाणां लवणस्य च ।
अतो ऽनुरूपं स्नेहं च गन्धं सङ्क्षिप्तमेव च ॥

सुवर्णकोट्यो बहुला हिरण्यस्य शतोत्तराः ।
अग्रतो भरतः कृत्वा गच्छत्वग्रे समाधिना ॥

अन्तरा पण्यवीथ्यश्च सर्वे च नटनर्तकाः ।
सूदा नार्यश्च बहवो नित्यं यौवनशालिनः ॥

भरतेन तु सार्धं ते यान्तु सैन्यानि चाग्रतः ।
नैगमा बलवृद्धाश्च द्विजाश्च सुसमाहिताः ॥

कर्मान्तिकान्वर्धकिनः कोशाध्यक्षांश्च नैगमान् ।
मम मातऽस्तथा सर्वाः कुमारान्तःपुराणि च ॥

काञ्चनीं मम पत्नीं च दीक्षायां ज्ञांश्च कर्मणि ।
अग्रतो भरतः कृत्वा गच्छत्वग्रे महायशाः ॥

उपकार्या महार्हाश्च पार्थिवानां महौजसाम् ।
सानुगानां नरश्रेष्ठो व्यादिदेश महाबलः ॥
